home.hero_title: A shop that takes WhatsApp orders in 10 minutes
home.hero_subtitle: List your catalog, share the link, buyer builds a cart, and you get the order in WhatsApp as a ready receipt.
home.hero_note: Sign in with Google or email. No marketplace fees.
home.demo_hint: This is how the receipt lands in your chat. Tap plus — the receipt recalculates.
home.for_1_text: QR menu instead of paper. Update the stop-list in one click.
home.for_2_text: Catalog link instead of statuses. Buyer sees prices and stock.
home.how_1_text: Set a name, link, and WhatsApp number. Choose: delivery, pickup, or both.
home.how_2_text: Upload a photo, price in tenge, and stock. Buyer sees only what is on sale.
home.how_3_text: Buyer builds a cart and taps “Order via WhatsApp”. The receipt with name and phone lands in your chat — that is WhatsApp handoff.
home.benefit_1_text: Orders go straight to you. No 20–30% cut like Glovo or Wolt.
home.benefit_2_text: The storefront opens by link or QR. No sign-up needed.
home.benefit_3_text: Show names in three languages. Store prices in tiyn, buyer sees tenge.
home.benefit_4_text: Each shop links to one number and mode. More outlets — more shops.
home.limits_text: Saying it upfront to keep expectations clear.
home.limit_1: No item options: clarify size and add-ons in the note.
home.limit_2: No online payment: buyer pays on pickup or by transfer.
home.limit_3: No app: seller gets a browser dashboard, buyer gets a link.
home.limit_4: No own delivery: deliver yourself or use pickup.
home.final_text: One link instead of a paper menu and Direct chats.
home.contacts_text: Questions about shops and orders — message on WhatsApp or email.
